PDF Split by Size

Split a PDF into parts that each stay under a target file size — pages are added and the real byte size is measured.

PartPagesSize

Parts are measured by actually saving them, so limits are enforced on real bytes. Large PDFs may take a while — everything runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a PDF file.
  2. Set the maximum size per part in MB.
  3. Click "Split" — parts are built and measured for real.
  4. Download all parts as a ZIP, or individually.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the size limit enforced?

Pages are added one by one and each part is actually saved and measured, so the size limit is enforced on real bytes — not estimates.

What if one page alone is bigger than the limit?

Yes — a page can never be cut in half, so an oversized single page becomes its own part and is flagged.

Is my PDF uploaded?

No — splitting happens entirely in your browser.
